(iv) It is not consciousness. Is it not aggregate? With exception of consciousness, the remaining aggregates are not consciousness, but aggregates. With the exception of consciousness and aggregates, the remaining ones are neither consciousness nor aggregates. They are not aggregates. Are they not mental aggregate? Yes.

End of Exposition Chapter on Terms.

II. Process (Pavatti)

1. Chapter on Origination Uppādavāra

1. Chapter on the Present (Paccupannavāra)

Positive (Anuloma) Person (Puggala)

Matter aggregate arises to this person. Does feeling aggregate 50. arise to that person? To those at the birth-moment of non-percipient beings matter aggregate arises: feeling aggregate does not arise to those persons. To those at the birth-moment of five-aggregate persons matter aggregate arises and feeling aggregate also arises. Feeling aggregate arise to this person. Does matter aggregate arise to that person? To those at the birth—moment of immaterial persons feeling aggregate arises; matter aggregate does not arise to those persons. To those at the birth-moment of five-aggregate persons feeling aggregate arises and matter aggregate also arises. (Feeling aggregate arises to this person. Does perception aggregate arise to that person? Yes. Perception aggregate arises to this person. Does feeling aggregate arise to that person? Yes.)
